questions.q: How should the app know which tasks were "completed today"?
options: A: completed-at timestamp set on Done, cleared on leaving Done
B: use updated-at of Done tasks
questions.reason: Recommended; updated-at changes on any edit so B gives wrong counts; PRD FR-09 requires the metric

questions.q: What does a habit's "completion progress" show?
options: A: current-period state + streak + rate over 30 days / 12 weeks
C: % of habits done today only
questions.reason: Recommended; covers PRD streak indicator and progress story

questions.q: How many items per list must the app handle without paging?
options: A: up to 1,000 per type, no paging
questions.reason: Recommended; single-user MVP, keeps API/UI small and filters instant

questions.q: What accessibility level must the UI meet?
Can two plans share the same priority order?
options: A: yes, ties by earlier start
questions.reason: Recommended; drag-reorder is out of scope, avoids cascade updates

result: No critical ambiguities detected worth formal clarification. Remaining Partial categories (observability, import/export, multi-tab concurrency) are low impact for a local single-user MVP.
